# Without node the value cannot be computed at build time. html has no runtime
# that names the js scheme, so the build fails — and the message says node,
# because that is the thing the machine is missing.
#
# Emptying PATH is what makes this run the same way on a machine that has node
# and one that does not.
env PATH=

! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
stderr 'needs node on PATH'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import lib "js:./lib"
import app "sngl:app"

const greeting = lib.shout("hello world")

component main ui {
    text(value=greeting)
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- lib/index.ts --
/** @sngl-pure */
export function shout(s: string): string {
    return s.toUpperCase();
}
